services.name: Anthropic API (token-metered)
services.notes: Extrapolated from 6 days of paid invoices May 10-15 ($180.64 = $30.11/day). Auto-replenish triggered 2-3x/day on May 12-14. ~7.5x step-change from ~$115/mo baseline pre-2026-04-09 credit exhaustion. 78% of total LLM spend; primary target for attribution work in #296. Includes both Mac Claude Code and office2 OpenClaw traffic — not yet segmented (the dev-vs-felix split is what #296 unblocks).

services.name: Anthropic Claude Monthly (Max plan)
services.notes: Plateaued at Max since Feb 2026. Was $21.25 Pro Aug-Nov 2025, ramped through Nov 2025-Jan 2026. Unknown how much Mac Claude Code usage is absorbed by this envelope vs spilling to the metered API line — open question to confirm during #296 execution.

services.name: ChatGPT Plus (includes Codex CLI)
services.notes: Flat for 9 consecutive months. Confirmed 2026-05-15: no separate Codex CLI charges beyond the ChatGPT Plus subscription. Spec-kitty review cycles (which run Codex) are absorbed in this envelope. Marginal cost of Codex per spec-kitty review is effectively $0.

services.notes: 3 months at this rate. Specifically Gemini API consumption under the intentional.biz GCP project; not other GCP services.
